question: Ritu, Sameer and Isha started a business by investing ₹1,350, ₹1,470 and ₹1,380 respectively. If the total profit at the end of the year is ₹1,330, what will be Isha's share in the profit received?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the time of investment is constant, Profit Ratio = Capital Investment Ratio.

Capital Ratio = 1350 : 1470 : 1380 = 45 : 49 : 46

Total ratio parts = 45 + 49 + 46 = 140 parts

140 parts = ₹1330 ⇒ 1 part = 1330 ÷ 140 = ₹9.5

Isha's share = 46 parts = 46 × 9.5 = ₹437

**∴ The correct answer is ₹437.**
